response.text: Invoice 802 is a credit memo with a negative amount, which the notes said never occurs; that's a data-convention deviation, not necessarily an error, so I'll note it cautiously. Invoice 671's journal shows 3801.24 vs the invoice 3792.24, a transposition-style difference of 9.00. Journal 1406 is the only unbalanced entry. Now let me check the 538 unlinked AP journals against payments.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" FROM public."GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' AND h."JRNL_NO" NOT IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM public."APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO" LIMIT 10
SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_AMT" FROM public."APPAYM" p JOIN public."APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_AMT" <= 0 OR p."PAY_DT" < i."INV_DT" LIMIT 20
